div.head: Ps Cn for 20
div.ab: Si quis delinquens in foresta nostra capietur, penas luet secundum modum et genus delicti.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 623 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: If any offender is taken in our forest, he shall suffer penalties according to the manner and kind of the offence.
